server.name: io.github.wklm/ios-web-bluetooth
server.description: MCP server to ship Web Bluetooth on iPhone Safari via the WebBLE extension.
server.title: iOS Web Bluetooth (WebBLE)

attribution.purpose: Attributes agent-introduced activations to the MCP channel for the Weekly Agent-Introduced Activations (AIA) metric.

tools.description: Return a runtime detection snippet for navigator.bluetooth and window.webbleIOS, plus notes covering every way the detection can go wrong on iPhone Safari.
tools.name: webble_detect_ios_support

tools.description: Return the canonical install steps, a runnable code snippet, and an attribution token for shipping Web Bluetooth on iOS Safari via WebBLE in the given framework + package manager.
tools.name: webble_install_plan

tools.description: Return the W3C Web Bluetooth spec URL, a one-paragraph summary, and implementation caveats for a specific method (e.g. navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice).
tools.name: webble_spec_citation

tools.description: Return a ready-to-paste code snippet for a canonical BLE profile (heart-rate, battery, cgm, lock, beacon, peripheral-chat) with preconditions and spec citations.
tools.name: webble_example

tools.description: Explain one of the iOS-only premium surfaces (backgroundSync, notifications, liveActivity, beacons, peripheral, whiteLabel) with a runnable code example and App Store requirement.
tools.name: webble_premium_guide

tools.description: Return a diagnostic checklist plus the single most common fix for one of four WebBLE failure modes (extension-not-detected, device-disconnects, gatt-operation-failed, notifications-not-firing).
tools.name: webble_troubleshoot

tools.description: Read the WebBLE best-practices guide, optionally filtered by topic.
tools.name: webble_dev_best_practices

tools.description: Search the WebBLE documentation index by keyword.
tools.name: webble_dev_search_docs

tools.description: Browse the monorepo directory tree with optional depth and gitignore filtering.
tools.name: webble_dev_list_structure

tools.description: Search curated source file examples by keyword.
tools.name: webble_dev_find_examples
